# Reference, differentiation, and provenance

## Actually observed
The pre-existing local upstream master was sampled at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 seconds before the treatment was written. That inspection found a copper burin opening, centered bee print, sequential anatomy roundels, late yellow/blue washes and tissue-covered credits. No claim is made that this sampling was continuous viewing or a listening review.

- Film: https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar/releases/download/films/engraving.mp4
- Observed bytes: 86,347,627.
- SHA-256: 4a699dd8e3cb33c3c6fb5d81794b4a9634afe3c61f2269a95dd0593403eaebd5.
- Existing download metadata identified 40 seconds, 1920×1080, 24 fps.
- Workflow and style library were read before production. DEMO.md was read only after TREATMENT.md was written.

## Learned, not copied
Warm laid paper, plate mark, tapered variable-width strokes, form-following hatch families, one light direction, a camera that reads the sheet, and pigment appearing as an event are retained. No bee, anatomy fact, wing-hook design, score, narrator, title, branded credit, or actual source stroke is carried over.

Six concrete differences:
1. Story: an imagined pod releases one winged seed, rather than a museum label explaining an insect.
2. Opening: paper and a closed seam, not a burin cutting copper.
3. Signature action: valves open and an engraved seed leaves its parent.
4. Camera: travels from seam to plant, then follows release and resolves into a two-object relationship.
5. Score: original 72 BPM lute-like phrase, two pauses, and a new late sustained interval. No upstream audio is used.
6. Ending: empty pod and airborne seed remain on the plate. No tissue guard or copied sign-off.

## Implementation difference
All geometry is new authored Bézier/analytic geometry. Strokes have a tapered swell profile. Paper is a fixed seeded texture. Ink is not grey shading; its tone is made by lines. The one pigment is a clipped, multiply-composited rose wash, arriving from the wing root. Typography is localized to Chinese with a serif font rather than pretending that a Latin script face supports Chinese calligraphy.

## Reference material in delivery
The final source bundle includes these attribution notes but does not redistribute the original reference video or audio. The private study contact sheet is kept out of the production ZIP.
